record.scope: MARSHTOMP, MUDKIP and SWAMPERT (the queued units; the only units declaring MUD_BUBBLE in the catalog). The WATER_SPRING passive of these units is separate and not described here.

dispatch.note: requiresTarget is false: MovingState casts it with a null target as soon as pp >= maxPP and canCast, without first walking up to an enemy; AttackingState can also cast it with a target, but the strategy ignores the target either way

record.summary: Self-heal then a cooldown reset. The caster requests a heal of 10 / 20 / 40 / 80 (80 fallback; table by caster stars) on itself with apBoost 1 and the cast's crit flag, so its own AP and critPower scale the request. handleHeal is called in this order (core-mechanics.md section J2): the wound branch first - a wounded recipient gets no HP, but with BLOODMOON weather and a Blood Stone owned by its player the same call requests addShield(round(0.3 x stones x the raw requested heal), recipient, apBoost, crit) with the recipient as the shield's caster, which the entity addShield (Big Eater Belt) turns into the final shield; then the guard hp > 0 && !status.protect (an unwounded Protected recipient gets nothing; Rune Protect alone does not block); then the modifiers (AP, crit, BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED x1.3, burn x0.5, enraged x0.5, ZENITH x1.2), Math.round and the cap at missing HP; the post-modifier overheal on a Grass-synergy recipient requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal), which also raises current HP. 'No direct HP healing' therefore does not mean 'no shield or max-HP / current-HP effect'. Requested amount, handleHeal's returned healReceived / overheal and the final stored hp / maxHP / shield are three different things. Then pokemon.resetCooldown(250, pokemon.speed) stores round(250 / (0.4 + 0.007 x speed)) in pokemon.cooldown - 353 at speed 44, 227 at speed 100 - replacing whatever value was there (also a longer one). That is a stored timer value, not a guarantee of the next action or of the actual attack timing: the attacking and moving states count it down and may overwrite it, and entering either state sets it to 0.

declaredRaw.formula: cooldown = round(250 / (0.4 + speed x 0.007)) using the caster's current speed
declaredRaw.note: requested base 250; 353 at speed 44, 227 at speed 100 (stored value, not an attack time)

effects.resolution: resetCooldown(250, speed) assigns pokemon.cooldown = round(250 / (0.4 + 0.007 x speed)) (353 at speed 44, 227 at speed 100) and replaces any earlier value, longer or shorter. AttackingState.update resets the cooldown to the 1000-based value at the start of an attack update (attacking-state.ts:22-25) and counts it down by dt otherwise (:110); MovingState.update sets a movement value (:23) and counts down (:65); entering either state sets the cooldown to 0 (:117, :181). So this stored value only means 'the next update of the current state that finds cooldown <= 0 acts'; it does not guarantee when the caster next acts or attacks (state changes, other writers and the unit's own speed changes intervene), and the strategy reads pokemon.speed without the paralysis halving that AttackingState applies to its own reset.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars (pokemon.stars - 1); the 4-star entry 80 and the fallback 80 is declared in the table but unused by the three bound baseline classes (stars 1, 2, 3). Cooldown reset (250) does not depend on stars. maxPP is 60 and range 1 for all three.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No state is kept; each cast heals independently and resets the cooldown again. No modes.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested heal: 10 (MUDKIP) / 20 (MARSHTOMP) / 40 (SWAMPERT) before AP and crit; handleHeal's returned healReceived / overheal come after the wound, protect, modifier, rounding and missing-HP steps; the final stored hp / maxHP / shield also include the Blood Moon / Blood Stone addShield request and the Grass addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal) request with their item helpers. Cooldown: requested base 250, stored round(250 / (0.4 + 0.007 x speed)) = 353 at speed 44, 227 at speed 100 - a timer value, not a timing guarantee.

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (handleHeal, addShield, addMaxHP, resetCooldown) and the real MudBubbleStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units, boards and call targets (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, sections SHARED_HELPERS and IMPORT_RECHECK_2); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (1 star, HP 50/100, speed 44): heal request 10 -> HP 60, cooldown 353; speed 100 -> 227; a prior 5000 is replaced; a wounded caster under Blood Moon with a stone gets addShield(3) and no HP; a full-HP Grass caster gets overheal 10 and addMaxHP(4) (final 104).
